formula: It will not be long before + clause

formulas.formula: It will not be long before + clause

example: It will not be long before the bus arrives.
exampleZh: 不用多久，巴士便會到達。

examples.en: It will not be long before the bus arrives.
examples.zh: 不用多久，巴士便會到達。
examples.highlight: It will not be long before the bus arrives.

rules.zh: 雖然 before 後面的事情將會在未來發生，但動詞一般使用現在式。不用多久，火車便會到達。
rules.en: Do not normally use will after before Although the event concerns the future, the verb after before normally uses a present form. It will not be long before the train arrives. It will not be long before the train will arrive.

rules.zh: 在這個句型中，It 是形式主語，並不是指前文提到的某件物件。
rules.en: It does not refer to a particular object In this expression, It is an impersonal or introductory subject. It does not refer to a previously mentioned thing.

rules.zh: 說話者預計事情很快便會發生。如果事情只是很微弱的可能性，便不宜使用這個句型。
rules.en: The sentence expresses a fairly confident prediction The speaker expects the event to happen soon. Do not use this structure when the event is only a weak possibility.

rules.zh: 不用多久，食物便會準備好。 詞語【It won't】常見於對話及較輕鬆的寫作。本練習統一使用完整形式 It will not。
rules.en: The contraction is acceptable It won't be long before + clause It won't be long before the food is ready. It won't is common in conversation and informal writing. This exercise uses the full form It will not for consistent practice.

rules.zh: 事情很快便會發生。 事情要很久之後才會發生。
rules.en: Do not confuse it with the opposite expression It will not be long before... = The event will happen soon. It will be a long time before... = The event will not happen soon.

rules.zh: 沒過多久，嬰兒便睡着了。 這個過去式結構與目標句型相關，但不屬於本練習的目標。
rules.en: The past form is a different structure It was not long before + past-tense clause It was not long before the baby fell asleep. This past form is grammatically related, but it is not the target of this exercise.

benefits.zh: 自然地表示某事即將發生你不需要反覆使用 soon 或 very soon，也可以自然地預測某件事即將發生。兩句意思相近，但第二句把「等待時間不會很長」的感覺表達得更清楚。
benefits.en: It gives a natural way to say that something will happen soon Instead of repeatedly using soon or very soon, you can use this structure to make the prediction sound more natural. Compare: The shop will open soon. It will not be long before the shop opens.

benefits.zh: 把目前情況與未來結果連接起來你可以先描述目前正在發生的情況，再預測不久後的結果。隨着需求增加，不用多久，課程便會滿額。 讀者可以輕易明白說話者為甚麼作出這項預測。
benefits.en: It connects present evidence with a future result You can first describe what is happening now and then predict what will happen soon. With demand increasing, it will not be long before the course is full. The reader can easily understand why the prediction is being made.

benefits.zh: 作出有根據而且頗有信心的預測這個句型並不是說事情現在已經發生，而是表示事情預計會在短時間後發生。
benefits.en: It helps you make cautious but confident predictions The structure does not state that the event is happening now. It shows that the event is expected after a short period.

benefits.zh: 增加句子開首的變化核心句型可以放在條件句、原因句、句首補充語或報告動詞之後。這樣可以避免每一句都以 It 開始，使文章的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It allows different sentence openings The core expression can follow a condition, reason, introductory phrase or reporting verb. This helps prevent every sentence from beginning with It.

benefits.zh: 適用於說話、作文、報告和簡報你可以使用這個句型討論社會轉變、個人進步、科技發展、業務增長、建設項目、環境趨勢，以及即將準備完成的事情。
benefits.en: It is useful in speaking, essays, reports and presentations You can use it to discuss: changes in society personal progress developing technology business growth construction projects environmental trends events that are nearly ready.
